# Purchase Order PO-ALPHA-DG-0001

**Project:** Project Alpha - 2 MW DG sets  
**Status:** DRAFT  
**PO date:** 2027-01-20  
**Contractual delivery:** 2027-10-28  
**Vendor quote:** Q-D1-20270111-R1 (rev 1)

## Parties

| | |
|---|---|
| **Vendor** | Tarangini Gensets Pvt Ltd (D1), Pune, Maharashtra - GSTIN 27AAACT0000D1Z4 - bids@tarangini-gensets.example |
| **Bill to** | Alpha Data Centres Pvt Ltd (synthetic), GSTIN 27AAACA0000Z1Z9, Pune, Maharashtra |
| **Ship to** | Project Alpha site - 24 MW Tier-III Data Centre, Plot A-7, Chakan MIDC Phase II, Chakan, Pune 410501, Maharashtra, India |

| 3 | `TANK-DAY-990L` | Fuel day tank with level transmitter (990 L) | 4 | 624,000.00 | 2,496,000.00 |
| 4 | `SYNC-PNL-11KV` | Synchronising & load-sharing panel (11 kV, 4 incomers) | 1 | 22,800,000.00 | 22,800,000.00 |
| 5 | `EXH-STACK-30M` | Exhaust stack with residential silencer (30 m) | 4 | 1,746,000.00 | 6,984,000.00 |

## Terms & conditions

1. Contractual delivery: on or before 2027-10-28 (required on site 2027-11-15).
2. Liquidated damages: 0.5% of order value per week (or part) of delay beyond the contractual delivery date, capped at 10% of order value.
3. Warranty: 24 months from commissioning or 30 months from delivery, whichever is earlier, or 5,000 running hours; defects rectified at site within 72 h of notice.
4. Factory acceptance test: witnessed load test per ISO 8528-6 (100% / 110% load, transient response), 5 days, Owner and Engineer present; despatch only after signed FAT report.
5. Submittals: GA, foundation and exhaust layouts, fuel schematic, alternator data, synchronising logic and protection settings within 14 days of PO; Engineer review 10 days.
6. Compliance: ISO 8528, IEC 60034 alternators, CPCB IV+ / MoEFCC emission norms with type-approval certificate enclosed before PO release, PESO approval for fuel storage where applicable.
7. Bank guarantees: advance against ABG of equal value; 10% performance bank guarantee valid for the warranty period plus 3 months.
8. Price basis: firm, ex-GST; GST 18% charged on invoice per prevailing law.
9. Reference: vendor quote Q-D1-20270111-R1 rev 1; takeoff from dg_2mw_genset_spec.pdf.
